text:
zoe: heads up: deploy-bot paused the umbrella chart promotion for orders-service during the eu-west canary. mismatch between chart.lock and values.image.tag. @carlos can you triage? :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion ID prom-20260323-04 PAUSED. Reason: chart.lock references subchart orders-worker v1.8.2 but values set image.tag=v1.9.0 which resolves to different digest in eu vs us registries. Canary failed consistency check. See /deploy/prom-20260323-04/plan

carlos: looking. our chart-bump pipeline updated values to v1.9.0 but the subchart was not published to eu registry due to a replication lag. so eu canary pulled v1.8.2 digest.

pm-ryan: change window ends in 30m. options?

zoe: 1) pin values.image.digest to the eu digest and continue; 2) rollback values.image.tag to v1.8.2 and run canary again; 3) abort promotion until registries converge.

carlos: functional diff between 1.8.2 and 1.9.0 is only a logging tweak and a non-breaking label change. low risk to pin. prefer pin+promote so we don't miss the window.

sre-oncall: agree with pin as long as we add a short monitoring window and an automatic rollback hook. I can add a temporary alert for increased 5xxs and pod restarts during the first 20m.

release-coordinator: if we pin, include a clear release note and add an action item to revert to v1.9.0 when eu registry has the artifact. also add a ticket to prevent this class of replication issue.

carlos: preparing a tiny `values-prod-eu.yaml` override and a PR now. PR will include rollback playbook and verification steps. snippet to apply locally:
```
helm upgrade orders ./charts/orders --namespace prod --values values-prod-eu.yaml --wait
# or with set
helm upgrade orders ./charts/orders --namespace prod --set image.digest=sha256:77a1c2... --wait
```

zoe: pinging @release-coordinator for manual promote after CI. I'll kick off CI.
deploy-bot: Note: Manual promotion requires `release-coordinator` approval. Use `deploy-bot promote --id prom-20260323-04 --manual-ack <user>` to continue.

carlos: PR opened: https://git.redwood/orders/compare/pin-eu-digest-20260323 (CI running). PR description contains rollback steps and monitoring checklist.

pm-ryan: approve to keep on schedule. please add a one-line entry in release notes: "Pin orders-service image digest in prod to avoid cross-region tag drift during chart promotion." We'll mark as non-user-facing.

sre-oncall: CI green. I'll stand by and flip on alerts.

release-coordinator: manually approving promote now.

deploy-bot: Promotion prom-20260323-04 proceeding (manual ack by release-coordinator).

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. prod-eu orders-service pods now running pinned digest sha256:77a1c2...; rollout 5/5 ready.

sre-oncall: monitoring live. no 5xx spike. will keep alerts for 20m then downgrade.

carlos: created follow-up ticket to add chart.lock vs values validation and registry replication check to our release CI: https://git.redwood/infra/issues/505

zoe: releasing note posted to #release-notes. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
